body:
---

Writing is eating your week, and AI can help you reclaim those hours. We're breaking down the best AI writing tools designed specifically for small business owners who need copy that converts—fast.

**This Week's Top Picks**

**Notion AI**
Write, edit, and brainstorm without leaving your workspace. Best for: Teams already using Notion who want lightweight AI help built right in. **Price:** Free + $10/mo. [Try Notion AI Free →](https://notion.so/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Copy.ai**
Generate marketing copy, social posts, and ad variations in seconds from simple prompts. Best for: Solo founders and small teams who need volume fast and don't mind some editing. **Price:** Free + $36/mo. [Try Copy.ai Free →](https://copy.ai/?ref=YOURCODE)

**Surfer SEO**
Write content that ranks on Google by analyzing top-performing pages and giving real-time optimization guidance. Best for: Anyone serious about organic traffic who wants data-driven content strategy. **Price:** $89/mo. [Try Surfer SEO →](https://surferseo.com/?ref=YOURCODE)

*(Honorable mentions: Jasper for marketing teams needing brand consistency, Writesonic for quick blog posts and landing pages.)*

---

**Quick Tip**

AI writing tools work best when you give them context. Instead of "write a landing page headline," try "write 5 landing page headlines for a SaaS tool that helps freelancers track time—our main competitor emphasizes automation, but we're emphasizing simplicity." Better input = better output, every time.

---

Save time, ship better copy.
